facts.fact: Malawi's Lands Minister said in an interview that the ministry has digitalised lease approvals and is comparing physical files with its Land Information Management System.

systems.owner: Ministry of Lands, Housing and Urban Development

facts.fact: Malawi's Lands Minister said in an interview that the ministry holds its land records in a Land Information Management System, against which a land audit checks physical files, and that it commissioned the new K965 million Ntchisi Land Registry.

MWI.note: Land services decentralised to councils; no office connection stated.
